context: Two friends discuss a small accident over coffee, with mock-excuses
purpose: Teach: 仲良く/限っ/接触/伺っ/問う/ラッキー/もったいない/言い訳

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 聞いてよ、今朝ね、駐車場で接触事故っちゃったの…
lines.en: Listen, this morning I had a little fender-bender in the parking lot...
lines.style: Soft confessional tone, drawing out vowels gently

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: えっ、大丈夫だった？怪我とかなかったの？
lines.en: What? Are you okay? You weren't hurt or anything?
lines.style: Warm concerned barista voice, leaning in attentively

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: うん、相手の方もすごく優しくて、丁寧にお話を伺ってくれて、仲良くお話できたんだ。
lines.en: Yeah, the other person was super kind, listened politely, and we actually got along well.
lines.style: Relieved dreamy tone, slight smile in voice

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: それはラッキーだったね。普通は責任を問う感じになっちゃうのに。
lines.en: That's lucky. Usually it turns into a blame-game situation, you know.
lines.style: Calm reassuring barista cadence, slight chuckle

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: でもね、私が今日に限ってスマホ見ちゃってて…言い訳できないの。
lines.en: But honestly, of all days, I was looking at my phone... I have no excuse.
lines.style: Sheepish apologetic tone, voice trailing off softly

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あー、それはもったいないミスだったね。ま、誰にでもあるよ。
lines.en: Ah, that was a really avoidable mistake. Well, it happens to everyone.
lines.style: Gentle teasing barista warmth, no judgment

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: ね、今度から気をつける。あ、このラテ美味しい〜！
lines.en: Yeah, I'll be more careful from now on. Oh, this latte is delicious!
lines.style: Bright mood shift, cheerful sing-song melody

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: でしょ？まあ事故ったお詫びってことで、もう一杯おごるよ。
lines.en: Right? Well, as a sympathy gift for your accident, next one's on me.
lines.style: Playful generous barista voice, smile clearly audible
